newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Fedsure buys stake in Msele Financial.
newsitem.headline: Fedsure buys stake in Msele Financial.

text.p: South Africa's Msele Financial Holdings, the financial services arm of Thebe Investments Corp, announced on Thursday that Fedsure Ltd had bought a 25 percent stake in the company.

Fedsure will subscribe for compulsory convertible preference shares of about 40 million rand with compulsory conversion in two years time. The final value of conversion will depend on the value of Msele at that time.

Msele aims to use the funds to fulfill its financial obligations following the recent acquisition of Bophuthatswana Building Society and Future Bank which becomes part of Citizen Bank, the largest black-controlled banking group in South Africa.
Msele said the agreement with Fedsure marked another milestone in black empowerment with a significant stake in a wholly black-owned company being sold to an established business.
